mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear night near Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 49 degrees and a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

On September 10th, Verona police were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunter's Cove Way for a burglary in progress. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody after a firearm was discharged, and he was transported for medical treatment before being booked into the Dane County Jail.

There is plenty to do in town. Today you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, join the fun with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, and catch live music at Paddy Mac's or visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market.
On September 10th, officers responded to a burglary incident where a handgun and a shell casing were recovered, though fortunately, no one was injured by the gunshot.
Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
